image_description: A large, ornate pipe organ situated on a wooden balcony within a church or concert hall. The organ features a Gothic-revival style wooden case with three main towers of vertical metal pipes of varying heights, creating a symmetrical stepped silhouette. A decorative chandelier hangs in the foreground to the right, partially obscuring the view. The background shows white arched walls and ceiling.
